sentences.text: Theresa Mary May -LRB- née Brasier ; born 1 October 1956 -RRB- is a British politician who has served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom since 2016 .	Prime Minister of the United Kingdom	Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

She has been the Member of Parliament -LRB- MP -RRB- for Maidenhead since 1997 and Leader of the Conservative Party since July 2016 . The daughter of a vicar , May grew up in Oxfordshire .	vicar	Vicar (Anglicanism)	Oxfordshire	Oxfordshire

After unsuccessful attempts to be elected to the House of Commons in 1992 and 1994 , she was elected as the MP for Maidenhead in the 1997 general election .
